name: Unabated Ticket
description: Click a price on the Unabated odds screen; see the bet and its Kelly stake in a side panel. An Edges tab lists every positive-edge line (main and, optionally, alternate spreads/totals) across every team sport Unabated prices, with Chrome notifications for new ones. A Bets tab and per-line flags show which lines and games you already have a bet on, read from a local bets service (Kalshi, Novig, BetOnline) and from the Novig web app while it is open; the service also keeps the team crosswalk the panel learns from bets the board joins by venue id.
